provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS original capability gap-closure master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A quoted HSTS max-age is a syntax error, so the directive is ignored and the response has no HSTS protection at all.

groundTruth.rationale: RFC 6797 grammar allows only an unquoted delta-seconds value. A quoted value makes the directive unparseable, so user agents ignore it and no max-age applies; the protection is absent even though the header is present.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request.
The case asserts the invalid-syntax reading, not that this deployment would have been safe with a longer duration.
